review_basis: registered MHLW model SDS Section 5 source fields
semantic distinctness and fire-response practice value

decisions.rationale: Gasoline-specific suitable-agent set is commercially important and distinct from the existing ethyl-acetate negative-choice question.
Gasoline's prohibited rod-water instruction is a direct high-value safety proposition for the primary Class-4 material.
Large-fire spray-water fallback creates a meaningful boundary against the rod-water prohibition.
Move containers only if safe is a separate fire-ground decision rather than an extinguishing-agent recall variant.
Cooling an immovable container and surroundings is a distinct conditional response.
Continued post-extinguishment container cooling adds a separate temporal response boundary.
Kerosene small-fire agent set is explicitly size-scoped and source-defined.
Kerosene large-fire agent set tests a materially different fire-size decision from C007.
Acetone spread-risk condition requires selecting a non-spray alternative and adds a distinct suitability boundary.
Upwind firefighting position is a source-explicit responder-protection rule with practical value.
Dry sand as an ethanol extinguishing option is a distinctive material-specific agent proposition.
Do not move a heat-exposed ethanol container is a clear conditional boundary distinct from safe-movement cases.
Removing the ignition source when safe is a direct fire-response priority from the registered Section 5 field.
Methanol re-ignition risk is a distinct post-extinguishment hazard requiring continued vigilance.
Ethyl-acetate container spray cooling is materially different from canonical OTSU4-Q-000002, which tests unsuitable direct-stream extinguishing.

collision_review.note: No B12 answer-defining proposition materially duplicates canonical 161. Material, fire-size and response-condition distinctions are retained only where the registered Section 5 field changes the decision.

source_review_scope: Final canonical source verification remains separate after integration.
